title: The Town That Forgot the Stars
intro: This quiz covers Nia and Ben's investigation into light pollution and the night sky.

questions.prompt: What did Nia and Ben notice when they looked at the night sky?
choices: Only a few faint stars were visible
questions.explanation: Nia and Ben noticed only a few faint stars were visible in the night sky.

questions.prompt: What was hiding the stars above the town?
questions.explanation: Too much artificial light was hiding the stars above the town.

questions.prompt: What did Nia and Ben compare in their schoolyard experiment?
choices: A bright bare lamp and a shielded lamp
A warm bulb and the Sun
questions.explanation: They compared a bright bare lamp and a shielded lamp in their schoolyard experiment.

questions.prompt: Which change did Nia and Ben suggest to the town council?
choices: Turning on brighter signs all night
Using shielded lamps, warm bulbs, and timers
questions.explanation: They suggested using shielded lamps, warm bulbs, and timers.

questions.prompt: What happened during the town's first Star Night?
choices: Dozens of stars became visible in the darker sky
Everyone stayed inside because of rain
The town added more bright lights
questions.explanation: During the town's first Star Night, dozens of stars became visible in the darker sky.
